refusal.eval_finding_outdated: This finding is outdated: its lines are no longer part of the pull request diff, so it cannot become an eval case.
refusal.eval_agent_missing: The agent that produced this finding no longer exists, so there is no agent to evaluate.
refusal.eval_finding_undecided: Accept or dismiss this finding first. An eval case needs a decision to know what to expect.
refusal.not_found: This finding or eval case could not be found.
refusal.generic: Could not open the eval case: {message}

alreadyInSet: This finding is already in the eval set. You are editing the existing case.

invalidReason.notObject: Must be a single JSON object
invalidReason.missingKeys: Needs the keys file, start_line and end_line
invalidReason.extraKeys: Only file, start_line and end_line are allowed — remove any other keys
invalidReason.file: file must be a non-empty string
invalidReason.lines: start_line and end_line must be positive whole numbers
invalidReason.order: start_line must not be after end_line
invalidReason.relocate: Move the expectation onto a changed line of the diff

serverReason.unparseable: The text is not a unified diff
serverReason.no_hunk: The diff has a file but no hunk
serverReason.multiple_files: The diff must touch exactly one file
serverReason.file_mismatch: file must be the file the diff changes
serverReason.line_not_positive_integer: Lines must be positive whole numbers
serverReason.start_after_end: start_line must not be after end_line
serverReason.outside_hunks: The lines are outside the changed hunks of the diff

saveError.eval_expectation_type_changed: The decision on this finding changed while the modal was open, so the expectation type changed. Close and reopen to continue.
saveError.eval_case_exists: This finding is already in the eval set.

spendNote: Calls the model and costs money

result.summary: expected {expected, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}}, got {matched}

saveFailing.title: Save a failing case?
saveFailing.body: The last run of this case failed. You can still save it as a known-failing case.

discard.title: Discard changes?
discard.body: You have unsaved changes to this eval case. Closing now loses them.
